'''Cartilage''' is a body part generated from [[butcher]]ing most animals. It has no use in the [[meat industry]](or any industry for that matter), and can be dumped without a second thought. 

Its category in stockpiles is "Body parts" inside "Refuse".

Some fish, such as [[shark]]s, are notable for having cartilaginous skeletons. These fish do not drop bones, only cartilage.

Note that dwarves consider cartilage useful (like bones), so they will not dump it automatically, even if you have the {{menu icon|y}}→Standing orders→"Workers dump other objects" option enabled. It does not rot on its own either.
